physics-killer-09.title: Work and Mechanical Energy Conservation
physics-killer-09.goal: Analyze the principles of Work and Mechanical Energy Conservation and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
physics-killer-09.material: Mu nuclear fusion reaction $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$, huremu hwechidimbu chimwe nechimwe: $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, neutron: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$. Simba rinoenderana ne $1\,\mathrm{u}$ rinova $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$, uye kinetic energy yezvidimbu zvisati zvaita reaction hairatidzwe. Simba $E$ rinoburitswa nereaction iyi uye kana momentum ye $\mathrm{^4He}$ neneutron dzakaenzana uye huremu rario ndi $4:1$, ndeupi mubatanidzwa wakarurama wekinetic energy yeneutron zvichitevedzana?
physics-killer-09.s.s1.prompt: Mu nuclear fusion reaction $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$, huremu hwechidimbu chimwe nechimwe: $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, neutron: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$. Simba rinoenderana ne $1\,\mathrm{u}$ rinova $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$, uye kinetic energy yezvidimbu zvisati zvaita reaction hairatidzwe. Simba $E$ rinoburitswa nereaction iyi uye kana momentum ye $\mathrm{^4He}$ neneutron dzakaenzana uye huremu rario ndi $4:1$, ndeupi mubatanidzwa wakarurama wekinetic energy yeneutron zvichitevedzana?
physics-killer-09.s.s1.explain: $\Delta m=5.0301-5.0101=0.0200\,\mathrm{u}$ saka $E=\Delta mc^2=0.0200\times930=18.6\,\mathrm{MeV}$. Sezvo momentum yezvidimbu zviviri mushure yakaenzana, $K=\dfrac{p^2}{2m}\propto\dfrac1m$ uye $K_{He}:K_n=1:4$. Saka $K_n=\dfrac45\times18.6=14.88\approx14.9\,\mathrm{MeV}$, $K_{He}\approx3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$. Kupidigura hukama hwemass ndiyo nhema ② $3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$, kupatsanura simba nehafu ndiyo nhema ③, kuverenga $\Delta m$ sa $0.0400\,\mathrm{u}$ ndiyo nhema ④.
